title: D CORE MPO 12C OM3 LSZH 1 Meter Multi-Mode 40G/100G Fiber Patch Cord

items.h: Jacket Type: LSZH (Low Smoke Zero Halogen)

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The D CORE MPO 12C OM3 LSZH 1 Meter Multi-Mode Fiber Patch Cord delivers high-speed 40G/100G network performance with low insertion loss and reliable connectivity. Designed with LSZH (Low Smoke Zero Halogen) jackets, it ensures safe installation in indoor environments. Perfect for data centers, FTTH, enterprise networks, and high-density network applications, this MPO patch cord supports multi-mode 12-core connections for seamless high-bandwidth communication.


Specifications:

  • Model: D CORE MPO 12C OM3
  • Fiber Type: Multi-Mode (OM3)
  • Core Count: 12C
  • Jacket Type: LSZH (Low Smoke Zero Halogen)
  • Length: 1 Meter
  • Connector Type: MPO/MTP
  • Transmission Speed: 40G/100G
  • Applications: Data centers, FTTH, Enterprise LAN, SAN, High-speed networking
  • Features: Low insertion loss, High reliability, Easy installation, Safe indoor use


Uses:

  • High-speed data center connections
  • FTTH and enterprise networks
  • High-density server racks and SANs
  • 40G/100G network backbones
